identity: Jazz musician and trumpeter · United States · 1901–1971
title: Louis Armstrong's birth chart
metaDescription: Louis Armstrong's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.6° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 11.6° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 11.6° into Leo — the second decan, which the old scheme hands to Jupiter. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 22.5° Cancer, Venus at 7.2° Virgo, Mars at 12.9° Libra. Mercury in a water sign reads as thought steeped in tone and memory; Venus in an earth sign reads as attraction that grows by reliability; Mars in an air sign reads as effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mars and Uranus — a sextile holding at 0.1°. A sextile pays out only on effort; the scheme calls it opportunity rather than gift. Behind it, the Sun sextile Mars at 1.3°, and the Sun trine Uranus at 1.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. The Sun in Leo at 11.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Virgo at 7.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Libra at 12.9° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Capricorn at 4.3° is in fall; Saturn in Capricorn at 11.1° is in domicile. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives fire 3, earth 3, water 2, air 2, and cardinal 6, mutable 3, fixed 1 across the modes. Jupiter, Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aries for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.2° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 7.5°.
